children: Anheuser-Busch is investing $23 million in its brewery in Fort Collins, Colorado to boost production of Michelob ULTRA. The investment is part of a $600 million planned U.S. investment package across 2025 and 2026, and will allow the brewery to produce 25-oz cans of Michelob ULTRA to meet growing demand, the company says. Anheuser-Busch is also opening a new training center for technical skills at the brewery, part of its plan to upskill more than 90% of its manufacturing workforce in the next five years, according to the company. (elias.schisgall@wsj.com)
